summary: Sagimet Biosciences Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a follow-on offering of 29,166,700 shares of Series A common stock at $6.00 per share. The offering is underwritten by Leerink Partners, TD Cowen, Guggenheim Securities, and others, with expected delivery on April 28, 2026. This is a standard secondary offering under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3). No special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, going-private, or restructuring are involved. The filing is purely a capital-raising event for the issuer.
